rules.statement: A co-owner should be allotted the portion which contains his improvements so far as is practicable.
rules.supporting_quote: Whenever possible, co-owners should be allotted the portions containing their improvements. A co-owner is not entitled as of right to be allotted the portion containing his improvements.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 33 of the Partition Law No.21 of 1977
